content: Hi, I live in Seattle and I make $85,000 a year. I have a car loan.
Thanks, Maya. I'll keep that in mind for your budget.
Quick update: I just moved to Portland. I also paid off my car loan last week!
Congratulations on paying it off! That frees up room in your budget.
Can you suggest a credit union near me?
Since you live in Seattle, BECU is a popular credit union near you.
That's wrong, I moved to Portland.
Sorry about that. In Portland, OnPoint Community Credit Union is a good option.
What should I prioritize with extra cash this month?
I'd put extra money toward your car loan balance first.
I paid that off, remember?
What's the APR on the Platinum card?
The Platinum card has a purchase APR of 24.99%.
